Shell Heavy Oil Fractionator DMC Example ​

System description ​

The subsystem of the Shell Heavy Oil Fractionator model is the following.

It consists of four First Order Plus Dead Time models. The identified models are all open-loop stable and also and .

Unit-step response model ​

The unit-step response model can be analytically obtained from the system model by using the unit-step Laplace-domain model, which is .

The unit-step response of the model is then obtained by inverse Laplace transform:

The original model is described in minutes and the sampling period is 4 minutes, i.e. the discretization is carried using :

The remaining unit-step response models:

The unit-step response models are then simulated from up to the point where steady-states are reached.
